subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Public-Private Partnerships
description: A quick, practical guide to Public-Private Partnerships.

hook.text: Banks have the data. Governments have the intelligence. Apart, each sees only half the picture.

buildup.text: Public-private partnerships let banks and law enforcement share information to find financial criminals.

discovery.text: The UK's Joint Money Laundering Intelligence Taskforce has led to freezing millions in criminal funds.

twist.text: Privacy laws limit what can be shared. Every partnership must balance security with civil liberties.

climax.text: The best AML outcomes happen when public and private sectors work together instead of in parallel silos.

punchline.text: Share the data. Find the criminals. Protect the privacy.

quiz.question: Why are public-private partnerships important for AML?
options: Each side has information the other needs
Banks don't want to do compliance alone
Governments want to take over banks
